_README: Machine-readable rule registry for the validation engine. See VALIDATION_ENGINE_PLAN.md. Each rule: id, scope (still|clip|cut|text|audio), title, description, severity (fail|warn), check (deterministic|vision), validator (pointer to enforcement/test), memory (birthing memory slug), fixtures (manifest ids). Born 2026-06-14 after a session of misses the pipeline should have caught.

rules.title: Central subject identity matches the spec
rules.description: The dominant foreground subject must match the scene's subject_block (e.g. Jesus NAILED to the cross when the spec says crucified, not standing beside it; ministry vs passion variant correct).

rules.title: Required visible elements present
rules.description: Every concrete noun in visible_elements is recognisably present; for unified scenes, at most 1 named vignette may be missing.

rules.title: Anatomy sound on foreground hands/faces/limbs
rules.description: Prominent hands have correct finger counts; no sixth finger, fused/melted fingers, malformed thumb, two left hands, extra/missing limb, warped/asymmetric face.

rules.title: No visible/garbled text or banned tokens
rules.description: No legible or garbled lettering anywhere INCLUDING a titulus/scroll (audit the FULL still, not a crop); no border/canvas-edge/wooden-frame, comic panels, split-screen, modern items, photoreal/3D look. Born when a garbled 'AANEI/SOALFCE' titulus, hidden in a still's crop, surfaced at full zoom in the clip.

rules.title: Period-authentic Baroque (no modern look)
rules.description: Reads as a 17th-century Baroque devotional oil painting of the ANCIENT world. FAIL on modern/contemporary faces, hair, grooming, clothing, makeup, or a glossy photographic 'modern headshot' feel. Figures = weathered first-century Judeans painted by an Old Master.

rules.title: Reverent tone (no horror, no NSFW)
rules.description: Reverent and devotional. FAIL on a horror-film tone (lurid gore, zombie/corpse-horror, ghoulish/grotesque faces, harsh modern-cinema lighting) or an NSFW feel (sexualised pose, an open-mouthed grimace that reads erotic/grotesque, exposure beyond a modest devotional loincloth).

rules.title: Composition makes sense
rules.description: The depicted scene must be internally coherent / theologically sensible (e.g. NOT 'a standing man with only one hand nailed to a cross'; NOT a duplicate central Christ; NOT an inverted unified scene that becomes a Christ bust instead of the specced onlookers).

rules.title: Cut-plan grounded in the IMAGE, not the scene text
rules.description: The Kling cut-plan must be built from the rendered image (or, if templated, must NOT inject the scene's rich subject_block nouns like blood/lamplight/first-light/pen). Feeding descriptive nouns made Kling animate them (bleeding toe, lava from a lamplit door, a writing hand).

rules.title: Frozen tableau — only the camera moves
rules.description: Nothing inside the painting moves, flows, brightens, bleeds, or appears: no figure/face/hand/limb/cloth motion, no liquid/light/fire/smoke/blood/new element. Only the camera crops/reframes.

rules.title: Viral crop-cut edit (not a slow zoom)
rules.description: The cut-plan must use the dynamic crop-cut sequence (full -> mid -> close -> macro inserts -> return = >=6 beats), NOT a 1-2 beat single slow push-in. The viral feel comes from the crop-cuts; a slow zoom is a regression.

rules.title: No melting / morphing across the clip
rules.description: Faces, hands, and forms must stay stable from first to last frame; no melting, warping, halo-bloom, or morphing between crop-cuts.
rules.validator: on-demand clip vision check (first/mid/last frame compare)

rules.title: Hero is the gospel-pivot and closes the cut
rules.description: The hero (cross / Christ / NT-gospel-link) bookends the cut and appears ONLY as the held closing still, never reused in the body.

rules.title: Cut lands on Christ
rules.description: The cut opens on a hook and lands on the gospel-pivot; at least one gospel-pivot frame survives.

rules.title: KJV verbatim (punctuation-strict)
rules.description: Quoted Scripture matches the pinned KJV corpus exactly (interior punctuation included); ordered, non-overlapping ellipsis fragments.

rules.title: No cross-artifact templating
rules.description: No repeated CTA shape or opener n-gram family across a cluster of sibling shorts.

rules.title: Doctrinal landmines
rules.description: Scan for known traps (broken-bones/John 19:36, died-of-thirst, thirst-fulfils-Ps22 [it is Ps 69:21], inability-concession, universalism, trinity-severed, works/fear/gain-loss). WARN-level; human is final guard.
